title: Ghost Pizza Bagels
ingredients:
Bagels
Marinara
Mozzarella Ghosts
Olives or Pepperonis
instructions:
Preheat oven to 350°. Cut mozzarella slices into ghost shapes using a paring knife.
Spread a thin layer of marinara over pizza bagel and top with ghost.
Bake until cheese is melty, 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut olives into little pieces for eyes. Dot the ghosts and serve.
